top_signals.title: Monte Paschi Chief Confident Investors See Value of Twin Deals
top_signals.summary: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA Chief Executive Officer Luigi Lovaglio said he’s confident shareholders in his bank as well as the two lenders he seeks to acquire will recognize the value of his twin takeover offers.

top_signals.title: Coca-Cola Is Said to Consider December Filing for India Unit’s $1 Billion IPO
top_signals.summary: Coca-Cola Co. is considering filing a draft prospectus in December for an initial public offering of its Indian bottling unit, according to people familiar with the matter.
